paras: Security firm Hacken counted <r>$1.18B</r> stolen across <g>107</g> crypto hacks in Q3, up 55% from Q2.
<u>Four incidents made up most of it:</u> Bitget ($350M+), Liquid Network (~$320M), a Coldcard wallet software flaw (~$114M) and Tectonic.
Most hacks were small. A few huge ones did the damage.
slides.source: Hacken Q3 2026 report via CoinDesk, Cointelegraph

paras: About <r>$907M</r>, or 77%, came from things a code audit didn't cover: hacked suppliers and dev tools, <g>known fixes never deployed</g>, and parts left out of the review.
<u>"The problem is always scope," says Hacken co-founder Andrii Matiukhin.</u>
An "audited" badge checks one piece of code at one moment, not the whole system.
